|lore=Alliance Intelligence expends considerable resources to infiltrate the Imperial military bureaucracy, but the ISB's security sweeps make these shadowy operations dangerous.
|game_text=Deploy on your spy at a site and cross spy to opponent's side. Spy is now Undercover. During your deploy phase, may voluntarily 'break cover' (lose Effect) if at a site. (Immune to Alter.)
|printings='''A New Hope''' — this page

|hatnote=For the Dark Side card, see [[Undercover (Dark)]].
|rulings=* If the character is persona replaced by a non-spy version, [[Undercover]] is lost and the character ceases to be [[Undercover]].<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Undercover</ref>
* The [[Undercover]] character prevents the opponent from Force draining at same site, and allows the owner to deploy to same site even without presence or Force icons. These benefits are the same even if the [[Undercover]] character is a droid.
* The [[Undercover]] character is inactive (for example it does not participate in battles) but outside of battle it may be targeted by Interrupts and anything that could make it dueled, hit, or lost.
* The owner may voluntarily break cover during their deploy phase.
* If the character's cover is broken (either voluntarily or by another card such as [[Lt. Pol Treidum]]), then [[Undercover]] is lost.
